text: You're looking for a quick and protein-packed meal that fits your gluten-free dietary needs, and I think the Chili Chicken recipe is a great fit. The dish is made with ground chicken, which is an excellent source of lean protein, and can be cooked in under 30 minutes, fitting your 45-minute time budget. Additionally, the ingredients are all gluten-free, making it a safe choice for you. With 28 grams of protein per serving, this recipe should help you meet your health goal of higher protein intake.
